events.info: The original Broadway sensation returns to the road! Celebrating 20 years ? Jersey style! They were just four guys from Jersey, until they sang their very first note. They had a sound nobody had ever heard? and the radio just couldn?t get enough of. But while their harmonies were perfect on stage, off stage it was a very different story ? a story that has made them an international sensation all over again. The show features all their hits including ?Sherry,? ?Big Girls Don?t Cry,? ?Oh What a Night,? ?Walk Like a Man,? ?Can?t Take My Eyes Off You,? ?Beggin?? and ?Working My Way Back to You.?Go behind the music and inside the story of Frankie Valli and The Four Seasons in the Tony Award®-winning, original Broadway sensation, JERSEY BOYS. From the streets of New Jersey to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame, this is the musical that?s too good to be true.

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: For most events, you can get tickets over the phone at the ardenland office at 601.487.2562. For any Broadway in Jackson events, please call 601.439.5229. The Thalia Mara Hall office number is 601.960.1535.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Thalia Mara Hall does NOT have a box office in the building. For most events, advance tickets can be purchased in person at the ardenland office - 622 Duling Avenue, STE 212, Jackson, MS 39216. Please call 601.487.2562 in advance of stopping by to make sure we are selling tickets for the event you are interested in! The ardenland office is open from 9AM - 6PM. On the day of the event, the box office opens inside Thalia Mara Hall two (2) hours before the doors open.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Most shows accept all major debit/credit cards and cash. Broadway in Jackson events do NOT accept cash.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: On the day of the event, the box office opens inside Thalia Mara Hall two (2) hours before the doors open. Tickets can be picked up anytime after the box office opens.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking offsite and on the street is free. There is a parking garage directly across from Thalia Mara Hall that requires you to pay at the gate.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Yes, there are accessible seating options at Thalia Mara Hall in Row P and Row MM in the orchestra sections on the floor. You can purchase ADA seating online. If you have any questions - do not hesitate to reach out to the ardenland office at 601.960.1535.
